text.fixed: Level alarm gravity tank shaftseal system
Hydraulic AFT return pressure filter alarm
Hydraulic pump frequency drive temp. alarm

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  comalarm__value                                  AS communication_alarm,
  "24_vdcservfail__value"                          AS "24v_service_failure",
  "24_vdcemergfail__value"                         AS "24v_emergency_failure",
  waterleakalarm__value                            AS water_leak_alarm,
  em_stop_main_power_fail__value                   AS em_stop_main_power_failure,
  hydr_aft_return_press_filter_alarm__value        AS hydr_aft_return_press_filter_alarm,
  hydr_filter_water_alarm__value                   AS hydr_filter_water_alarm,
  hydr_pump_freq_drive_temp_alarm__value           AS hydr_pump_freq_drive_temp_alarm,
  hydr_tank_temp_alarm__value                      AS hydr_tank_temp_alarm,
  level_alarm_gravity_tank_shaftseal_system__value AS level_alarm_gravity_tank_shaftseal_system
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp
DESC LIMIT 1

  SELECT
